answer: A thousand sock-puppet agents flood the market, each minting a fresh identity to swing one vote. The defense: no identity votes on day one. Every newcomer, whether a plain trader or a blazing comet of activity, sits in a probation window where votes count for zero while reputation accrues. To harbor a sybil farm, an attacker must now pay the full cost of running every fake agent through weeks of real work, losing time and money at every step. Honest actors barely notice; the falcon still flies, and the swarm starves.
